description: How one cut performs in one gemstone: its headline, eight measured scores against the T73 round brilliant in the same stone, and its pros and cons. For questions like 'is an oval a good cut for sapphire?'.

gemstone.description: Gemstone, as its slug. An alias stone (aquamarine, citrine, quartz, alexandrite) answers with the figures of the stone it shares optical constants with, and says so.
